description: Compare two or more exact package names side by side using live npm or PyPI metadata. Use this when you already know the candidate packages and need evidence for claims such as 'tool A is newer', 'tool B is still maintained', or 'these packages use different licenses'. It returns per-package registry metadata in input order, with field availability varying by registry. Missing or unpublished packages return found=false. Do not use it to discover unknown alternatives, estimate market size, or compare packages across different registries. Registry responses are cached for 5 minutes.

packages.description: Two to ten exact package names from the same registry, for example ['react', 'vue']. Use exact registry names, not search phrases or categories.

registry.description: Registry that all package names belong to. All compared packages must come from the same registry, and returned metadata fields differ slightly between npm and PyPI.

name: compare_competitors

comparisons.description: Per-package lookup results returned in the same order as the input package list. Some fields only exist for npm or only for PyPI, so consumers should treat absent fields as normal.

author.description: Package author when PyPI metadata includes one.

cached.description: True when the lookup came from the 5-minute cache.

created.description: Package creation timestamp when npm provides one.

description.description: Short package summary from the registry.

error.description: Fetch error when registry metadata could not be retrieved for this package.

found.description: True when the registry lookup succeeded and returned package metadata.

keywords.description: Registry keywords or tags associated with the package.

lastPublished.description: Publish timestamp of the latest version when npm provides one.

latestVersion.description: Latest package version known to the registry.

license.description: Package license metadata when provided by the registry.

name.description: Package name that was looked up.

totalVersions.description: Number of published versions when npm metadata includes a version history.

packages.description: Package names that were requested for comparison.

title: Named Package Comparison
